Waffles n Wheels Hills n Sips

Oakland, CA · Road

Waffles n Wheels Hills n Sips is a road group ride in Oakland, CA. It rolls every Thursday at 5:30 pm from Start not published (Strava members only).

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 5:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace isn't posted. Ask the host before you go, or say you're new when you arrive.
Check
Look at the Strava club the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Waffles n Wheels Hills n Sips group ride

A Thursday evening hills ride from an Oakland club that says it welcomes anyone who ever felt out of place on a traditional group ride. Riders split into Belgians and Eggos. The start is shown only to Strava members.
